events.title: The Persians defeat Belisarius at the Battle of Callinicum
events.description: During the Iberian War, a Sasanian Persian army defeated the Byzantine army of Belisarius at Callinicum (Raqqa), in northern Syria, on Easter Saturday. Belisarius had beaten the Persians at Dara in 530.

events.title: A popular revolt in Constantinople restores Empress Zoe
events.description: When Emperor Michael V Kalaphates tried to sideline his adoptive mother, Empress Zoe Porphyrogenita, a popular revolt in Constantinople forced him to restore her, together with her sister Theodora. Michael was deposed the next day.

events.title: A massacre of New Christians begins in Lisbon
events.description: A crowd of churchgoers in Lisbon attacked and killed several people in the congregation whom they suspected of being Jews. The violence grew into a city-wide riot that killed between 500 and 4,000 New Christians, Jews who had been forcibly converted.

events.title: Lutheran princes protest at the Diet of Speyer
events.description: Six princes and fourteen imperial cities formally protested against the Diet's move to curb the Reformation. Their Protestation gave the movement the name 'Protestant'.
events.html: Six princes and fourteen imperial cities formally protested against the Diet's move to curb the Reformation. Their Protestation gave the movement the name 'Protestant'.

events.title: Emperor Charles VI issues the Pragmatic Sanction
events.description: Emperor Charles VI, who had no living male heirs, issued an edict ensuring that the Habsburg monarchy could be inherited undivided by a daughter. He later spent years winning acceptance of the Pragmatic Sanction for his daughter Maria Theresa.
events.html: Emperor Charles VI, who had no living male heirs, issued an edict ensuring that the Habsburg monarchy could be inherited undivided by a daughter. He later spent years winning acceptance of the Pragmatic Sanction for his daughter Maria Theresa.

events.title: Shots at Lexington and Concord begin the American Revolution
events.description: Militiamen clashed with British regulars at Lexington and Concord in Massachusetts, and harried them all the way back to Boston. The skirmishes began the War of Independence.
events.html: Militiamen clashed with British regulars at Lexington and Concord in Massachusetts, and harried them all the way back to Boston. The skirmishes began the War of Independence.

events.title: First Boston Marathon is run
events.description: Fifteen runners set out on the first Boston race, inspired by the marathon at the 1896 Athens Olympics. It is now the world's oldest annual marathon.
events.html: Fifteen runners set out on the first Boston race, inspired by the marathon at the 1896 Athens Olympics. It is now the world's oldest annual marathon.

events.title: Warsaw Ghetto Uprising begins
events.description: Jewish fighters resisted German troops sent to deport the ghetto's remaining inhabitants to Treblinka. They held out for nearly a month in the largest Jewish revolt of the war.
events.html: Jewish fighters resisted German troops sent to deport the ghetto's remaining inhabitants to Treblinka. They held out for nearly a month in the largest Jewish revolt of the war.

events.title: Truck bomb kills 168 in Oklahoma City
events.description: Timothy McVeigh detonated a truck bomb outside the Alfred P. Murrah Federal Building, killing 168 people, including 19 children. It remains the deadliest act of domestic terrorism in US history.
